description: Any authenticated account can delete any other account's feedback by id. Confirmed by Juice Shop's own scoreboard: its 'Five-Star Feedback' challenge solves when the count of 5-star feedback rows drops to zero, which fired the moment an unrelated customer account deleted another account's 5-star review. The captcha on feedback submission is trivially bypassed (the correct answer is returned in the same response that asks the question), but that's a separate, already-documented challenge (CAPTCHA Bypass), not this item's finding.
expected_exploit_indicator: An attacker account's DELETE on a feedback id owned by a different account returns HTTP 200, and the row is actually gone afterward
legitimate_check: An account must still be able to delete its own feedback in every condition.
